article.title: Summary Of Ethiopia 2022/2023 Second Quarter Revenue By Component
article.description: The values for total domestic revenue mirror those of the total revenue and grants category. In the first quarter of 2021/22, the total domestic revenue was 106,282.90 million Birr. The budget allocation for the 2022/23 fiscal year is slightly lower at 438,851.30 million Birr. The figures for the first and second quarters of 2022/23 match those of the total revenue and grants category, with 97,886.40 million Birr and 110,459.40 million Birr, respectively.
